verdict.rationale: Docs confirm exporting notes to Google Docs or Sheets and exporting Slide Decks as PDF, satisfying the 'documents and spreadsheets' part of the story. However, there is no evidence of exporting to reference-manager formats (e.g., BibTeX, RIS, EndNote), a key part of the story for researchers. missing for 10: reference-manager export (BibTeX/RIS/EndNote), independent verification of export fidelity.
